title: Lesson IR V8.3.2
description: Canonical machine-readable Lesson Intermediate Representation for V8.3.2 Teacher-Ready Adaptive Classroom.

extensions.description: Reserved extension namespace. Core runtime must not depend on unknown extension keys.

LearnerEvidence.description: Learner evidence with truth-preserving provenance. sourceRef is not universally required; planning_assumption/unknown may have null sourceRef but require teacher confirmation.

ConditionalFeature.description: Conditional learning feature. When triggered=false, no learning-value fields are required. When triggered=true, triggerReason, learningValue, studentAction and expectedEvidence are required. observerEvidence is optional at feature level; CIS badge evidence is managed separately in cisEvidenceMap.
